bus-engine.wav

Bus Motor/Engine Sound Loop
Field recording by qubodup, published 6 June 2008 on Freesound.
https://freesound.org/people/qubodup/sounds/54909/

CC0 1.0 Universal
https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/

Game adaptation: a 4.643-second excerpt, mixed to mono at 32 kHz,
lightly equalized and level-matched, with a phase-aligned crossfade
for continuous looping.
